basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Customer Solutions Engineer
basics.summary: Customer-focused software engineer with 5 years of experience designing enterprise integrations, automating business processes, and delivering production solutions across technical and non-technical teams. Strong in API integration, data transformation, SQL, TypeScript, Java, troubleshooting, documentation, and translating operational requirements into reliable workflows.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Delivered enterprise integrations and workflow solutions for financial platforms while partnering with international teams and business stakeholders.
highlights: Led end-to-end delivery of production features and integrations, from requirements and API design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and support.
Defined API specifications, stored procedure interfaces, business logic, validation rules, and expected outcomes by collaborating across technical and business departments.
Built TypeScript and React features backed by Spring Boot, Java, Oracle SQL, JPA/Hibernate, and Apache Kafka pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions.
Engineered automated health checks and validation scripts to detect deployment regressions, improve troubleshooting, and increase operational reliability.
Produced system specifications, process flowcharts, maintenance guides, and troubleshooting documentation to support handoffs and long-term maintainability.
Harnessed large language models (LLMs) to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, and test iteration while validating their output.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Built and supported security tooling integrated with source code, developer environments, and CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: Built a React/Redux dashboard for automated vulnerability detection and remediation across development and CI/CD workflows.
Resolved risk-scoring logic flaws and implemented Jest and Cypress testing to improve reliability and reduce false-positive alerts.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Delivered tailored automation solutions for enterprise business processes.
highlights: Orchestrated C#/.NET and SQL automation solutions for OCR, HR, and fundraising workflows by identifying manual bottlenecks and translating requirements into implementations.

projects.name: Meal Planner
projects.description: Full-stack collaborative application for planning household meals and generating shared shopping lists
highlights: Delivered a multi-user SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Convex application with authentication, household onboarding, shared planning, real-time data, and edge-case handling
Harnessed large language models (LLMs) for implementation and debugging while validating outputs through testing, review, and product feedback
